source.headline: Cedar Comets: single-speaker-scope
source.context: One Cedar Comets supporter, Sam, said, "I am relieved." Sam was not speaking for a supporters group, and no other reactions were reported.

source.headline: Cedar Comets: conditional-support

source.headline: Cedar Comets: past-only

source.headline: Cedar Comets: reporter-tone
